column1: # Which DONOR sound goes into which of Pikachu's bank entries, for Rat of Doom's slot.
# Read by tools/build-sound-bank.py. Entry names are matched case-insensitively (the banks store
# `se_littlemac_smash_S03`; scripts and hash40 use lower case).
# OPTION A, CHOSEN 2026-10-18: swap audio inside Pikachu's own 61-entry bank, keep every label.
# Nineteen of the 61 are played ONLY by scripts Rat of Doom replaces -- his tilts, smashes and
# aerials, the old Quick Attack / Skull Bash / Thunder, the d-air landing -- so those nineteen take
# donor audio. Everything he still does as Pikachu (walk, run, jump, land, shield, rolls he kept,
# neutral-B, taunts, Final Smash, victory) keeps Pikachu's own sound. The 59 donor sounds do not
# fit in 19, so tools/sound-map.tsv points near-duplicates at one entry (Little Mac's three jab
# swings share one, Byleth's five n-air hits share one, Incineroar's eight side-B sounds share
# two). Option B -- growing the bank so all 59 fit -- is the backup if the sharing bothers him.
# The list of what is free came from mapping every entry to the Pikachu scripts that play it
# special_L02, final04..final04_09) are played by native status code and are never touched here.
